_comment: Igris-ai PROJECT harness manifest (FR-136). Declares the 7 core agents whose codex harnesses are mechanically regenerated from their canonical core/agents/<name>.md prompts (TD-021). Core ships only the SCHEMA (core/scripts/cli-adapters/manifest.schema.json); each project ships its own data manifest at its repo root. Canonical is the SOLE source of truth; every target listed here is a GENERATED artifact - editing a target file directly is a process error. Personal/Layer-2 customizations are NOT declared here - they live in an optional gitignored overlay at ~/.igris/registry/harness-manifest.personal.json (FR-139). FR-202 M4: the os_identity surface (TD-233) was retired — the orchestrator no longer projects an identity region into any harness's auto-read file. The per-harness delegation mechanism is now a CONTEXT LAYER (core/os/harness-specific/<harness>.md, loaded at Boot for the Detect-resolved harness), not a projected surface.
_harnesses_comment: Per-harness `delegation_model` — the applicability predicate for the harness-specific context layer (FR-202 M4). `native-static` = the harness loads Igris agents statically and a skill delegating via `subagent_type:<agent>` resolves directly (no harness-specific file needed). `dynamic-define` = the harness cannot load static Igris agents but defines subagents at runtime (e.g. Antigravity `define_subagent`/`invoke_subagent`); it has a `core/os/harness-specific/<harness>.md` file pointing at the shared delegation recipe, so the orchestrator is taught 'read ~/.igris/core/agents/<X>.md → define_subagent → invoke' ONCE at Boot, with ZERO per-skill branching. A harness absent from this map defaults to native-static. This is no longer a projected surface (the recipe was re-homed off the identity region into the harness-specific layer); the map survives only to select which harness-specific file applies.
